question: How should this app take money?

choices.label: No payments — free app or internal tool
choices.hint: The app does not process online payments or take cards.

choices.label: Stripe — test mode
choices.hint: No real money. Card 4242 4242 4242 4242 always succeeds.

fields.label: Stripe secret key
fields.hint: Dashboard → Developers → API keys. The one that starts sk_test_.

fields.label: Stripe publishable key
fields.hint: The same page. This one is safe in the browser.

fields.label: Webhook signing secret
fields.hint: Developers → Webhooks → your endpoint. Without it a payment cannot be confirmed.

choices.label: Stripe — real payments
choices.hint: Real cards, real money. Use your live keys.

fields.label: Stripe secret key
fields.hint: Dashboard → Developers → API keys, with the test toggle off.

choices.label: PayHere — sandbox
choices.hint: Sri Lanka: LKR, local cards, eZ Cash and mCash. No real money.

fields.label: Merchant secret
fields.hint: The same page. Used to sign and to verify the notification.

choices.label: PayHere — real payments
choices.hint: Real LKR payments from your live PayHere account.

choices.label: PayPal
choices.hint: Accepted almost everywhere, and the one people recognise. Buyers can pay without a card.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.hint: developer.paypal.com → Apps & Credentials → your app. Switch between Sandbox and Live at the top of that page.

fields.label: Environment
fields.hint: 'sandbox' while you build, 'live' when real money should move.

choices.label: Razorpay
choices.hint: Cards, UPI, netbanking and wallets in India, in rupees.

fields.label: Key ID
fields.hint: Dashboard → Settings → API Keys. It starts with rzp_test_ or rzp_live_ and belongs in the page.

fields.label: Key secret
fields.hint: Shown once, when the key is generated.

fields.label: Webhook secret
fields.hint: Settings → Webhooks. Without it a payment cannot be confirmed safely.
